function: DRL (PPO) learns the power split between common and private RSMA streams at the APs to maximize energy efficiency under URLLC constraints (p. 1, p. 3).
system: TDD cell-free massive MIMO with transceiver impairments, 10 APs with 10 antennas, 5 single-antenna users, 20 MHz, RSMA, carrier not stated, no RIS (p. 2, p. 4).
method: PPO reinforcement learning, fully connected DNN (4 layers, 64 neurons); state: user SINRs, action: stream powers, reward: energy efficiency with penalty terms (p. 3, p. 4).
data_channel: Custom simulator: correlated Rayleigh fading, phase noise, additive distortions; APs and users random in a 0.5x0.5 km square; no dataset mentioned (p. 2, p. 4).
test_conditions: No separate test set stated; EE evaluated over BLER 1e-5 to 1e-9, blocklength 200-400, impairment levels, and 3-15 antennas per AP (p. 4, p. 5).
baselines: SDMA-DRL (the same PPO without the common stream) and a Traditional Lagrangian dual transform method from [10] using long-term channel statistics (p. 4).
metrics: Energy efficiency in Mbit/Joule versus targeted BLER, blocklength, transceiver impairment levels, and antennas per AP; relative EE gains in percent (p. 4, p. 5).
q1_support: p. 2: "the quasi-static flat fading channel between the i-th AP and the k-th user is modeled as Rayleigh fading"; a custom correlated Rayleigh model, with no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured data anywhere in the letter.
q2_support: p. 4: "Other parameters are presented in Table I unless otherwise stated"; the letter describes no separate training and testing scenario, and Fig. 2 sweeps BLER, blocklength, impairment level, or antennas per AP in the same simulator.
q3_support: p. 4: "SDMA-DRL: Using PPO algorithm to solve the power allocation problem in (17), but without using common stream"; this is the proposed agent without the common stream (an ablation), and Traditional [10] is non-learned, so no earlier learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "DNN with 4 layers and 64 neurons per layer" gives the architecture only; no complexity order, operations, parameter count, or runtime is reported, and the only complexity remark (CSO, p. 4) is qualitative.
q5_support: p. 4: "We assume that all APs and users are randomly distributed over a square area"; the data come from the authors' own simulator, and no code or data link, public dataset, or measurement appears in the letter.
notes: Included as area 3, flagged for the reviewer: the learned action is the power split between the common and private RSMA streams, while the MR-type precoder directions are fixed from estimated channels (p. 2); if stream power allocation is not read as precoder design, the exclusion would be function. No RIS. q3 is 0 because SDMA-DRL is the proposed PPO agent without the common stream and Traditional [10] is non-learned.
